subject: general
question: Which ministry has launched the world's first multicentre phase III clinical trial to assess Ayurveda's efficacy in Rheumatoid Arthritis treatment?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Ayush**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Ayush** has launched the world's first multicentre phase III clinical trial to assess Ayurveda's efficacy in Rheumatoid Arthritis treatment.
 
• This initiative is a significant step in integrating traditional Indian medicine with modern medical practices.
 
• The clinical trial aims to provide scientific validation and global recognition to Ayurveda's potential in treating chronic conditions.
 
• It reflects the government's commitment to promoting and supporting traditional Indian medicine systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Ayush** was formed in **November 2014** to ensure the optimal development and propagation of Ayush systems of healthcare.
 
• Ayush stands for **Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy**.
 
• Rheumatoid Arthritis is a chronic inflammatory disorder that typically affects the small joints in hands and feet.
 
• Integrating Ayurveda in mainstream healthcare can potentially reduce the dependency on conventional drugs and their side effects.
 
• The ministry is also involved in various other research and development activities to validate and promote traditional Indian medicine on a global platform.
